svg.title: Spiti circuit route map, 16 to 24 September 2026
svg.desc: A map of the Shimla to Manali loop through Kinnaur and Spiti, showing eight numbered night halts in order: Sarahan, Chitkul, Kalpa, Tabo, Mudh in Pin Valley, Kaza, Losar and Chandratal, with high-altitude day stops at Kibber and Komic and the Kunzum La pass.
